prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production Unity 2.5D game enemy animation sprite sheet. Input image is ONLY the identity/silhouette and exact VIEW direction reference. Redraw this same Rusher, not a new creature. Materials: matte dark rock brown armor, warm gray-white sinewy limbs, restrained amber eye slit, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style matching AlienPurge. Camera fixed elevated 45 degrees, soft upper-left light. Lean athletic quadruped with very long sharp spear/wedge-shaped head and tall swept-back layered rocky armor blade along spine; dark brown plates, pale gray sinewy load-bearing legs, amber eye slit at front. FOUR limbs, single head; no sacs, no flower organs. Preserve the reference's blade-backed charging predator silhouette.
CRITICAL DIRECTION: FRONT view, face and spear nose toward bottom center of image, strictly symmetric front projection; NO sideways or diagonal turning in ANY of the 28 frames, even windup, charge and death.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR columns and 7 rows, 28 separate full character drawings. PORTRAIT canvas with width:height ratio 4:7, each equal square cell contains one complete creature within its central 70%, generous fully transparent gutters all around. No silhouettes touch, no cropped feet, no detached bits. Read frames left to right then top to bottom. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real articulated four-leg gait, alternating diagonal pairs, lifted feet and planted feet, stable torso. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breath poses, feet planted. Row4: FOUR WINDUP frames: progressively brace hind legs, lower spear head, draw torso backward ready to charge; last frame fully braced. Rows5-6: EIGHT sequential CHARGE SPRINT frames, head lowered and armor forward, vigorous alternating reach/push leg motions, body stays at the same scale and ground anchor. Row7: FOUR DEATH frames: limbs buckle, spear head and plates settle on floor, eyes darken, collapsed corpse, no explosion.
Every frame holds the EXACT SAME camera direction, identity, proportions, four legs and plate count. Real joint motion, no duplicate frames or whole-body-only transforms. Anchor feet at the same baseline and body at same center in each cell. Empty pixels true alpha 0, including holes between legs; no solid background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text/labels/grid, no VFX/projectiles. Render clean silhouette edges.
